The '''RTK111 system''' was a [[star system]] located in the [[Yminis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. It was located in grid square S-14 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and contained the [[planet]] [[RTK111]].<ref name="Origin" />
